board_guarantee: the board e-value is the arithmetic mean of the per-signal e-processes (valid under arbitrary dependence, Vovk & Wang 2021): under no change anywhere, P(it ever reaches A) <= 1/A. A board e-value of 20 is thus 'at most a 1-in-20 fluke', once, for the whole board — not per signal.

ddti_threat.meaning: peak censor attention on one term

ddti_novelty.meaning: newly-sensitive terms entering the deletion stream

gdelt_containment.meaning: terms loud abroad while censored at home

bleedthrough_pools.meaning: distinct GFW injector pools — a jump signals regional fragmentation

bleedthrough_capacity.meaning: peak parallel injector processes — fleet capacity on a border path

tor_bridge_cn.meaning: demand for unlisted Tor entry points from China — a surge reads as censorship pressure or fear rising

weibo_suppression.meaning: DDTI terms deleted AND denied hot-search attention at once

ioda_outages.meaning: shutdown-scale connectivity events detected by IODA's instruments

headline: single layer elevated: network
method: per-signal two-sided conformal Shiryaev-Roberts e-detectors; e-BH (arXiv:2009.02824) at alpha=0.1 selects which signals are reported elevated, controlling FDR under arbitrary dependence; per-layer and board-wide e-values merged by arithmetic mean (arXiv:1912.06116), which is valid for dependent e-values; a layer counts as elevated at merged e >= 20, i.e. at most a 1-in-20 fluke, or when one of its signals alarmed within the last 12 readings
caveats: layer co-movement is evidence of CO-MOVEMENT, not of a common cause: two layers can rise together under one directive or under one holiday; this reading reports the coincidence and does not name a cause
the guarantee is per READING and signals refresh on different cadences, so equal e-values mean different wall-clock rarity; readings_to_days gives the conversion for the ALARM threshold
a layer holding one signal cannot corroborate itself — corroborated=false marks those, and today that is the MODEL layer
signals still warming up contribute no e-value; they are neither evidence of calm nor of change
